g.text: Consumer trust zone: OnMaru-backend runner, secrets, test commands
Toolkit trust zone: pinned checkout, no secrets, no command execution
Observability zone: exported observations only, no CI verdict authority
GitHub Actions run pages and API (external, read by consumer)
Caller CI workflow (owns triggers, cache, credentials)
Bounded Actions artifacts (execution.json and envelope bytes)
Post-run OTLP exporter step (optional, separate verdict)
Ingest: bounded JSON, duplicate-key rejection, identity join
Telemetry transform: onmaru_ci metrics and reconstructed spans
Grafana Cloud tenant route and retention
drill-down link, no API call from Grafana
